## Support for Qt Quick Controls


We have added support for applications built with Qt Quick Controls in native desktop test suites.


When creating a Native Desktop test suite, users can choose whether to enable Qt command recognition. This option can also be enabled or disabled in an existing test suite by navigating to **Settings → Advanced** .


## Overriding Authentication Credentials via the API and CLI


Users can now override a test suite’s authentication credentials using the Retest API or the CLI.


To override authentication credentials via the API, include the following structure in the request body:


```text
{
"authentication": [
{
"username": " [email protected]  ",
"password": "secret",
"basicAuth": { "username": "staging", "password": "secret2" },
"otpRegistrationCode": "JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP",
"phoneNumber": "+15551234567",
"defaultClientCertificate": "qaCert",
"defaultPasskey": "qaPasskey"
}
]
}
```


For more information on how to use this feature, refer to the **CI/CD** section of your test suite.


## Exporting Test Suites via the CLI


We have added a new command to the testRigor CLI that allows users to export test suites directly to their current working directory.


The command syntax is as follows:


```text
testrigor forcepull [<suite>]
```


The command first downloads the specified test suite to a temporary directory. If the download fails, the contents of the user’s working directory remain unchanged.
